answer: Problem: key farms burst seats from one scheduler. Mechanism: lock 4.80 POA into a 9-cell stake trellis; each 0.53 cell needs a distinct non-kin countersignature. In a 40s prism window the joiner solves three incompatible slices (history, graph, timing) and XOR-folds them into a 20-byte ticket. For 48 minutes they emit a 2s liveness pulse every 8 minutes, six times, signed with that ticket. Cost: 4.80 POA locked three epochs, six live pulses. Verify: unique signers, ticket match, pulse windows ±3s. Failure: missed pulse, shared signer, or slice mismatch slashes 62% and freezes cells 5 epochs.
